description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.

 WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.

 Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.

 The Role: We are looking for a Quantitative Developer to join our team in Vietnam. This is an opportunity for a technically strong, early-career candidate to build the automation and tools that support critical business workflows. You will work alongside experienced engineers to solve technical problems, develop robust internal platforms, and improve the efficiency of complex systems. You will also gain hands-on exposure to production environments by helping monitor workflows, investigate issues, and support on-call activities

 What You'll Do:  

 
 Monitor production systems, scheduled jobs, data processes, and automated workflows; identify and bring up issues appropriately

 Investigate technical issues across applications, data processes, and infrastructure; contribute well-tested fixes under guidance

 Design, build, and maintain internal tools, automation, interfaces, and services that improve business workflows

 Improve system reliability, observability, documentation, and team productivity

 Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions

 Contribute to code reviews, testing, release validation, and user documentation

 Assist the on-call team with incident triage, diagnostics, communication, validation, and follow-up activities

 Identify repetitive manual tasks and build automation to reduce operational overhead

 
 What You’ll Bring: 

 
 Bachelor's/ Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

 Solid practical experience in Python and/or C++

 Good knowledge of Bash scripting and Linux environments

 Familiarity with version control systems such as Git

 Interest in automation, production systems, operational tooling, and reliable software delivery

 Strong analytical and logical thinking, with a methodical approach to solving problems

 Meticulous, with a high standard for accuracy, quality, and reliability

 A self-starter who takes ownership of assigned work and knows when to seek guidance or escalate

 Comfortable handling multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment

 Able to learn quickly and adapt to unfamiliar technologies and complex systems

 Effective and concise communicator in English, both written and verbal

 Solid understanding of Claude or other LLM tools, and an understanding of how to apply them effectively across debugging, problem analysis, solution design, testing, and documentation

 Uses LLM tools with sound judgment and critical thinking — as a force multiplier for quality, speed, and clarity, not as a substitute for engineering discipline

 Brings a continuous-improvement approach and contributes to improving team processes, documentation, and automation

 
 What We Offer: 

 
 Competitive and attractive compensation package with clear career road-map – where you feel challenged everyday

 We offer a strong culture of learning and development: training courses, library, speakers, share and learn events

 Learn from who sits next to you! Working in WQ you are surrounded by smart and talented people

 Premium Health Insurance and Employee Assistance Program

 Generous time-off policy, re-creation sabbatical leave (based on tenure), Trade Union benefits for staff and family

 Team building activities every month: Local engagement events, monthly team lunch – Employee clubs: football, ping-pong, badminton, yoga, running, PS5, movies, etc.

 Annual company trip and occasional global conferences – opportunity to travel and connect with our global teams

 Happy-hour with tea break, snacks and meals every day in the office!

 
 #LI-VP1
